protocol.frame_rx: CAN 0x047, 8 B: [cmd][d0][d1][d2][d3][d4][chkH][chkL]; cmd decoded by 0x355f0: 0x00 idle, 0x06 keyless request (d0: 0x00/0xff reject-start, 0x01/0xff, 0x7f seed request), 0x08 challenge/response word (BE32 d0..d3 -> c204), 0x90 key word (d0 = tag 1..4 = expected-word index, BE32 d0..d3 -> c1ec), 0xc9 begin key exchange
protocol.frame_tx: CAN 0x041, 8 B built at 0xffffc1c8 by 0x35738: [cmd][sub/status][4 data bytes][0][0][0]; cmd 0x07 = raw seed c208 BE; 0x09 = computed key word #c220 BE; 0x01/0x81 = verdict with status c224 (0x7f OK / 0x80 / 0x81 NG); 0xc6 = key exchange complete; 0xc8 = engine-off/ready notice
protocol.sequence: keyless sends 0x06/0x7f -> PCM answers 0x07 with seed c208 and computes expected response c200 -> keyless answers 0x08 with its computed word -> PCM compares c204==c200 (0x34f5c) -> verdict 0x81/0x01 with 0x7f/0x81 -> on OK: immo_authorized c1d0=1, state 3; separate 0xc9 + 0x90x4 exchange verifies/loads the 4 tagged key words c1f0..c1fc -> 0xc6 complete. All steps dynamically reproduced in the emulator (tests/test_immobilizer_dynamic.py).
protocol.immobilization_effect: c1d0==0 makes fuel_cut_bitmask_build 0xe2d4 set DAT_ffffa430 = 0x0003 (both rotor banks cut) - emulator-verified; also gates the key-gated CAN mains (0xdb58/0xdbf6 names) and lamp 0x2556c
